productionDate.note: The original stone was erected in 219 BCE. The surviving block preserves text from that carving as well as the 209 BCE addition.

dimensions.note: Measurements from the museum's stone and tile catalogue listing, not of the original cliff face.

currentCollection.note: Listed in the National Museum's online collection catalogue. The page does not state a gallery, storage area, or exhibition status, and gives no accession date.
currentCollection.noteZh: 著录于中国国家博物馆线上藏品目录。条目没有说明展厅、库房或展出状态，也没有给出入藏时间。

review.note: Draft object record built from the museum's collection page read on 2026-11-18. The removal of the stone from the cliff in the Qing dynasty is stated, but no dated event sequence or accession record is given.
review.noteZh: 草稿实物记录，依据 2026-11-18 阅读的馆方藏品页整理。页面提到清代将刻石从山崖凿下，但没有具日期的迁移经过或入藏记录。

notes: The museum describes the block as the rear half of the original stone. The front half is not recorded as extant on the cited page.
No catalogue number, excavation record, or accession date is given, so none is stored.
The fragment's condition is described only as 字已漫漶 (the characters are worn); no condition survey is cited.
notesZh: 馆方称此残石为原石后半部；所引页面未记原石前半部仍然存世。
页面没有馆藏编号、出土记录或入藏时间，故均不填写。
残石状况仅以「字已漫漶」概述，未引用保存状况调查。
